description: This is a React component file implementing the client-side UI for the 'Explore' section of a career navigation web app. It manages state, fetches filter options, handles user input for role searches, and renders components such as filters, search bar, role cards, and mindmap views.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes an input value to a trimmed string, converting undefined or null to empty.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input to an array of non-empty, trimmed strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses the salary range from a role object and returns minimum and maximum salary in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object, normalizing key names.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches active filter criteria such as industry, skills, salary range, and title query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React component managing the explore page UI, including search, filters, and result display.
